description: This file is a FastAPI-based backend API module for managing emoji reactions and listing emojis within a sports live stream platform. It provides endpoints to list available emojis, submit emoji reactions for specific events, and retrieve reaction summaries for events. It interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models and manages websocket notifications.
